question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Having a consistency that does not easily yield to pressure
solution:
The correct answer is **"Firm".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Firm"** means having a consistency that does not easily yield to pressure.
 
• It is a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
• It is an adjective that describes the quality of being unyielding or steadfast.
 
 
• Example: The firm grip of the rock climber helped him ascend the steep cliff.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ​** **Option 1, "Substantial", means having a large amount or size and is not a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
• Option 3, "Ramrod", refers to a rod used to clean the barrel of a firearm and is not a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
• Option 4, "Close", means near or in proximity and is not a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
